claims.exactBehavior: The exact checkbox stages and persists fade independently of the remembered namespace. Fading disables the custom namespace choice and uses the ideal tag colour. Actual Qt CanFadeColours=false storage rows remain solid; write predicate rows fade across differing namespace text colours and selected backgrounds. Real existing consumers retain raw/count/connector/ideal segments rather than colouring the whole concatenated label. Cancel and retained old Apply do not persist the draft; reopen restores the setting; live valid owners refresh without replacing input or selection.

referenceRecording.result: Executed the real TagPresentationPanel, ManageTagsPanel asynchronous decorator publisher and actual WriteFetch predicate rows on a copied basic fixture with synthetic cross-namespace local mappings/sibling relation. Captured exact labels, staged Cancel/UpdateOptions/reopen, fade/custom-namespace interlock, None/explicit-empty/named/missing/raw-spaced choices, real text/RGB segments and CanFadeColours. Actual storage terms disallow fades while write predicates allow them. Saved and inspected actual Qt selected/unselected PNGs at /tmp/sibling-colours-qt-selected.png and /tmp/sibling-colours-qt-unselected.png; the real write list is detached for paint capture without altering its class/data/options. Reference source files and non-fixture data untouched. Expected sandbox local API warnings are unrelated to direct Qt/DB capture.

limitations: Only two original finite preference leaves are proposed; Tag Presentation and tag-list/autocomplete parent families remain Partial.

All existing native sibling-annotation consumers use the shared runs: ManageTags storage rows and shared WriteAutocomplete in ManageTags, detached import/tag editors and both sides of sibling/parent dialogs. This slice does not add sibling annotations to native surfaces that never had them.
Native fonts/palettes/list clipping follow existing Slint presentation; expanded OR header/child topology, broader tag-list menus and keyboard navigation remain outside the slice.
Live native notification refreshes valid visible owners on a 100 ms owned subscription; pending menu/questions defer revision consumption, close stops the subscription.
Store/model/native regressions and native PNGs authored for hosted CI; no local Cargo tests/builds, mutation testing, pushes, canonical inventory or reference source changes.

claims.exactBehavior: The exact noneable namespace control uses use ideal tag colour, remains disabled while fade is checked, and preserves None, explicit empty, named/missing and raw whitespace values. None resolves the ideal namespace; empty resolves unnamespaced colour; missing/raw-spaced names resolve fallback. Fresh None controls retain disabled system text as Qt does. The typed legacy import and staged Options Apply/Cancel/reopen feed the real segmented ManageTags/write/relationship consumers, preserving logical tag mappings and drafts.
